items.headline: No More 15-Month Wait for Private Homeowners to Buy HDB Resale Flats
items.summary: The government has scrapped the rule requiring private property owners to wait 15 months before buying an HDB resale flat. The change takes effect immediately.
items.meaning: If you own or have recently sold a private home, you can now buy an HDB resale flat straight away without sitting out over a year first.
items.body:
The 15-month wait rule is gone. Private homeowners no longer have to sit out more than a year before they can buy an HDB resale flat. The government scrapped this rule with immediate effect, ending a restriction that has been in place for years.

The wait was originally introduced as a cooling measure to stop private property owners from jumping straight into the HDB resale market and pushing up prices. It applied whether you still owned your private home or had just sold it, which meant families looking to downsize were stuck waiting before they could even make an offer on a flat.

If you own a private property and want to buy a resale HDB flat, you can do it now. No countdown, no timing your sale around a rule, no forced rental gap in between. For owners who want to right-size or shift housing type, this is a meaningful practical relief that removes a real obstacle from their plans.
items.headline_zh: 私宅业主购买HDB转售组屋，15个月等待期正式取消
items.summary_zh: 政府已废除私宅业主购买HDB转售组屋须等待15个月的规定，新措施即时生效。
items.meaning_zh: 如果你名下有私宅，或者最近刚卖掉私宅，现在可以直接购买HDB转售组屋，不需要再等一年多。
items.body_zh:
15个月等待期已经取消了。私宅业主不再需要等一年多才能购买HDB转售组屋。政府即时废除这项规定，结束了这个已实施多年的限制措施。

这项等待期当初是作为降温措施推出的，目的是防止私宅业主直接涌入HDB转售市场、推高价格。无论你是仍然持有私宅，还是刚刚出售了私宅，这项规定都适用，这意味着想要缩小居所规模的家庭，甚至连出价都要先等上一段时间。

如果你目前持有私宅，想买一间HDB转售组屋，现在就可以行动了。不需要倒数日子，不需要配合规定来安排出售时间，也不需要被迫在中间租房过渡。对于想要调整居所规模或转换房产类型的业主来说，这是一个实实在在的解脱，去除了他们计划中真正的障碍。

items.headline: HDB Million-Dollar Resale Market Set for More Action After Wait-Out Rule Scrapped
items.summary: With private homeowners now free to enter the HDB resale market immediately, analysts expect more activity especially among larger, well-located flats that already trade above S$1 million.
items.meaning: Competition for premium HDB resale flats is likely to pick up, so buyers hunting for a big flat in a popular estate should be prepared to move quickly.
items.body:
With private homeowners now free to buy a resale HDB flat straight away, analysts expect competition to heat up at the top end of that market, specifically among large flats already trading above S$1 million.

Million-dollar HDB flats have become a regular feature of the resale market, concentrated mainly in mature estates like Bishan, Toa Payoh, Queenstown and the central corridor. These are exactly the flats that cash-rich private downgraders tend to go after. Before this rule change, those buyers had to wait more than a year before acting. That barrier is now gone, and some of them will move quickly.

If you are hunting for a large flat in a popular estate, expect to compete with buyers who have just come from private property and often have strong budgets to match. Get your finances sorted before you start viewing, know your maximum offer, and be ready to move when you find the right unit. Hesitating is now more costly than it was a week ago.
items.headline_zh: 等待期取消后，HDB百万元转售市场预计将更加活跃
items.summary_zh: 私宅业主现在可以即时进入HDB转售市场，分析师预计市场活动将会增加，尤其是已经以超过S$1百万成交的大型、地理位置优越的组屋。
items.meaning_zh: 高端HDB转售组屋的竞争可能会加剧，正在热门市镇寻找大单位的买家要做好随时出手的准备。
items.body_zh:
随着私宅业主现在可以直接购买HDB转售组屋，分析师预计顶端市场的竞争将会升温，尤其是已经以超过S$1百万成交的大型单位。

百万元HDB组屋已经成为转售市场的常客，主要集中在成熟市镇，如碧山、大巴窑、女皇镇以及中部走廊一带。这些正是手头宽裕、从私宅降级的买家最感兴趣的单位。在规定改变之前，这些买家须等待一年多才能行动。这道门槛现在已经移除，其中一些人会迅速出手。

如果你正在热门市镇寻找大单位，要准备好与刚从私宅市场出来、往往预算充裕的买家竞争。在开始看房之前先理清财务状况，清楚自己的最高出价，一旦找到合适的单位就要迅速行动。犹豫不决的代价，现在比一星期前高多了。

items.headline: Property Agents Face Tougher Rules: Fewer Fake Listings and Clearer Commission Fees
items.summary: The Council for Estate Agencies is raising industry standards with measures to stamp out fake or misleading listings and require agents to be upfront about the fees they charge buyers and sellers.
items.meaning: When you use an agent to buy or sell, you should soon see fewer bait-and-switch listings and have a clearer picture of what your agent will cost you.
items.body:
The Council for Estate Agencies is tightening how property agents must operate, targeting two long-standing frustrations in the market: fake or misleading listings, and murky commission structures. The new measures are meant to raise baseline standards across the industry.

Fake listings, where an agent posts a property that is already sold or does not exist just to generate calls, have been a persistent complaint from buyers and renters in Singapore. Commission arrangements have also been confusing for buyers in particular, who sometimes do not know who is paying the agent or how much. These rules push agents to disclose fees upfront and to only advertise genuine, available units.

In practice, you should start seeing fewer dead-end listings that waste your time. If you are selling, ask your agent to put the commission in writing before you grant any exclusive. If you are buying, expect agents to be more straightforward about how they are paid and whether they are co-broking with another agent. Neither change is dramatic, but both make the process a bit more honest.
items.headline_zh: 房产经纪将面对更严规定：杜绝假房源，佣金须透明
items.summary_zh: 房地产经纪理事会正在提高行业标准，措施包括打击虚假或误导性房源，以及要求经纪向买卖双方预先说明收费。
items.meaning_zh: 当你通过经纪买卖房产时，很快就会看到更少的诱饵式房源，也能更清楚地了解经纪的收费情况。
items.body_zh:
房地产经纪理事会正在收紧房产经纪的操作规范，针对市场上两个长期存在的问题：虚假或误导性房源，以及不透明的佣金结构。新措施的目的是提升整个行业的基本标准。

假房源，即经纪刊登已售出或根本不存在的单位来吸引来电，一直是新加坡买家和租客的投诉焦点。佣金安排对买家来说也往往不够清晰，有时甚至不知道是谁在付经纪费、又付了多少。这些新规定要求经纪预先披露收费，并只能刊登真实可购的单位。

实际上，你应该会开始看到更少浪费时间的无效房源。如果你在卖房，在给予经纪独家代理权之前，要求他们将佣金写进合约。如果你在买房，经纪在收费方式以及是否与其他经纪联合代理方面，将会更加坦诚。两项改变都不算重大，但都让整个过程更加诚信。

items.headline: Developers Now Have Up to 7 Years to Complete Large En Bloc Redevelopments
items.summary: The government has extended the maximum deadline for developers buying large collective sale sites to finish their projects, easing the stamp duty pressure that was making mega en bloc deals hard to price.
items.meaning: This could unlock large collective sales that were previously stuck, eventually adding more new homes to the pipeline over the next several years.
items.stat_label: max redevelopment deadline for large sites
items.body:
The government has extended the deadline for developers to complete projects on large collective sale sites, raising the maximum to seven years from the date they acquire the land. The change eases a key financial pressure that was making big en bloc deals hard to structure.

When a developer buys a collective sale site, they pay Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty upfront, which is refunded if they finish and sell all units within the required timeframe. For large sites with hundreds of units, the original window was often too tight to be realistic given the sheer scale of planning, approvals, construction and marketing. That made it difficult for developers to price a bid confidently, so many large sites simply did not attract serious offers.

For homeowners in older developments that have been exploring a collective sale, this change makes it more viable for a developer to table a credible bid on a big site. Do not expect anything to happen overnight, but some large collective sale proposals that were previously too risky to price may now find serious buyers over the coming years, adding future supply to the new homes pipeline.
items.headline_zh: 发展商可获最长7年时间完成大型en bloc重建项目
items.summary_zh: 政府已延长发展商收购大型集体出售地段后完成项目的最终期限，减轻了让大型en bloc交易难以定价的印花税压力。
items.meaning_zh: 这可能会推动此前陷入僵局的大型集体出售项目重新启动，在未来数年间为市场增添更多新房源。
items.stat_label_zh: 大型地段的最长重建期限
items.body_zh:
政府已延长发展商在大型集体出售地段完成项目的期限，从取得土地之日起最长可达7年。这一改变减轻了让大型en bloc交易难以成形的关键财务压力。

当发展商购买一个集体出售地段时，须预先缴付额外买方印花税（ABSD），若能在规定期限内完成并售出所有单位，则可获退还。对于拥有数百个单位的大型地段而言，原有的期限在规划、审批、施工和营销的庞大工作量面前往往显得过于紧迫。这使得发展商难以自信地给出竞标价，导致许多大型地段根本吸引不到认真的出价。

对于正在探讨集体出售可能性的旧发展项目业主而言，这一改变使发展商更有条件对大型地段提出具竞争力的竞标。不要期待事情一夜之间发生，但一些此前因风险过高而难以定价的大型集体出售项目，在未来数年内或许能够找到认真的买家，为新房市场注入未来供应。

items.headline: Forced Property Sales by Banks Hit a Six-Year High in First Half of 2026
items.summary: Mortgagee-sale listings, where banks sell properties to recover unpaid loans, reached their highest level since 2020 in the first half of 2026 as tighter financing conditions pushed more owners into default.
items.meaning: Rising financial stress among some property owners means more distressed units are appearing on the market, which can weigh on prices in affected segments and signal wider caution.
items.body:
The number of homes being sold by banks to recover unpaid loans hit a six-year high in the first half of 2026, the highest level since 2020. These forced sales happen when a borrower defaults and the bank steps in to sell the property to get its money back.

The jump to a six-year high reflects the cumulative strain of several years of higher interest rates. Many buyers stretched their budgets during the run-up in property prices, and higher monthly repayments have pushed some of them to the point where they can no longer keep up. This is not a crisis-level number, but it is a meaningful signal that financial stress among some property owners is rising.

For buyers, distressed listings occasionally offer value, but they come with complications around timelines and conditions, so go in with your eyes open. For the broader market, a cluster of forced sales in a neighbourhood tends to drag on nearby valuations, at least in the short term. If you are planning to sell in an area where mortgagee sales have been appearing, do not anchor your expectations to peak prices from a year or two ago. Price based on what comparable units are actually transacting at today.
items.headline_zh: 2026年上半年银行强制出售房产创六年新高
items.summary_zh: 抵押权人出售房产（即银行出售房产以追讨未偿还贷款）的挂牌数量，在2026年上半年达到2020年以来的最高水平，更严苛的融资条件将更多业主推入违约困境。
items.meaning_zh: 部分房产业主的财务压力上升，意味着市场上出现了更多被迫出售的单位，这可能会对相关市场板块的价格造成压力，也是需要广泛保持谨慎的信号。
items.stat_label_zh: 2026年上半年强制出售挂牌数量
items.body_zh:
2026年上半年，银行为追讨未偿还贷款而强制出售房产的数量，创下六年新高，达到2020年以来的最高水平。这类强制出售发生在借款人违约、银行介入出售房产以收回资金之时。

创六年新高的背后，反映的是连续数年高利率环境下累积的财务压力。许多买家在房价上涨期间将预算拉伸到极限，更高的每月还款额已将部分人逼到无力维持的地步。这个数字还未到危机级别，但却是一个有意义的信号，说明部分房产业主的财务压力正在上升。

对于买家而言，被迫出售的房产偶尔能提供物超所值的机会，但在时间表和条件方面存在诸多复杂因素，入市前要保持清醒。对于大市而言，某个地区出现一批强制出售，往往会拖累附近的估值，至少在短期内如此。如果你计划在强制出售房产频繁出现的地区售房，不要以一两年前的高峰价格作为参考。应根据同类单位今天的实际成交价来定价。

items.headline: Overall HDB Resale Market Slows, But Million-Dollar Flat Sales Keep Climbing
items.summary: Transaction volumes in the HDB resale market have eased in 2026, but sales of flats priced above S$1 million are bucking the trend and still rising, widening the gap between the mass market and the premium end.
items.meaning: If you are after a mid-range HDB flat, there is less competition than before, but expect no relief if you are chasing large flats in sought-after estates.
items.body:
The overall HDB resale market has become quieter in 2026, with transaction volumes easing compared to the busier years before. But inside that slower market, one segment is moving in the opposite direction: flats priced above S$1 million are still selling in growing numbers.

The million-dollar HDB flat used to be rare news. It is now a regular fixture of the market, concentrated in large units in mature, well-connected estates. While the mass market has softened and buyers of mid-range flats have more time and more choice than before, the premium segment has not followed. The gap between the two ends is getting wider.

If you are selling a typical three-room or four-room flat outside a prime location, you need to price sharply to attract offers because buyers have more options than before. If you are buying or selling a large flat in a sought-after estate, do not expect any cooling at that end. The market has effectively split into two stories and which one applies to you depends entirely on what type and location of flat you are dealing with.
items.headline_zh: HDB转售市场整体放缓，但百万元组屋销量持续攀升
items.summary_zh: 2026年HDB转售市场的交易量有所回落，但售价超过S$1百万的组屋销量却逆势上扬，中端市场与高端市场之间的差距进一步拉大。
items.meaning_zh: 如果你在寻找中端HDB组屋，竞争比以前少了；但如果你追求的是热门市镇的大单位，则别指望情况会轻松。
items.body_zh:
2026年整体HDB转售市场趋于平静，交易量与此前更热闹的年份相比有所回落。但在这个放缓的市场内部，有一个板块正朝着相反方向发展：售价超过S$1百万的组屋销量仍在持续增加。

百万元HDB组屋曾经是罕见新闻，如今已成为市场常态，集中于成熟、交通便利的市镇中的大型单位。大市虽已降温，中端组屋买家也拥有了更多时间和选择，但高端板块却没有跟随放缓。两个端口之间的差距正在扩大。

如果你正在出售位于非黄金地段的普通三房或四房组屋，必须精准定价才能吸引出价，因为买家的选择现在比以前多了。如果你是在买卖热门市镇的大单位，在那个板块别指望有任何降温。市场已经分化为两种走势，哪种走势适用于你，完全取决于你所涉及的单位类型和地点。

items.headline: Condo Resale Volumes Picked Up in June 2026 as Buyers Returned
items.summary: Private condo resale transactions rebounded in June after a quieter stretch, with buyers returning to the secondary market in stronger numbers.
items.meaning: If you are selling a resale condo, there are more active buyers out there now than earlier this year.
items.body:
Private condo resale transactions picked up in June 2026 after a quieter stretch earlier in the year. More buyers came back to the secondary market, pushing volumes higher compared to the months before.

The resale condo market had been subdued through parts of 2025 and into early 2026, as buyers adjusted to elevated prices and tighter borrowing conditions. The June uptick suggests some of that hesitation is starting to lift, likely helped by mortgage rates pulling back from their peaks and giving buyers more confidence about what they can afford.

For sellers, June was an encouraging sign that more genuine buyers are out there again. If you have been sitting on the fence about listing your unit, conditions are more favourable now than they were earlier this year. That said, do not price off last year's peak valuations. Buyers who have returned are paying attention to value. Price at current market levels and your chances of completing a sale are considerably better.
items.headline_zh: 2026年6月买家回归，condo转售交易量回升
items.summary_zh: 私人condo转售交易在6月份经历一段较为淡静的时期后回弹，买家重返二手市场，交易量明显增加。
items.meaning_zh: 如果你正在出售转售condo，现在市场上的活跃买家比今年早些时候多了。
items.body_zh:
私人condo转售交易在2026年6月回升，结束了年初以来一段较为淡静的时期。更多买家重返二手市场，推动交易量较前几个月走高。

condo转售市场在2025年部分时段及2026年初一直处于低迷状态，原因是买家对偏高的价格和更严格的借贷条件持观望态度。6月的回升迹象表明，部分犹豫情绪正在消散，这很可能与房贷利率从高峰回落、给予买家更大的负担信心有关。

对于卖家而言，6月是一个令人鼓舞的信号，说明市场上重新出现了更多真实的买家。如果你一直在观望要不要挂牌，现在的条件比今年初更有利。不过，不要参照去年的高峰估值来定价。回归的买家很注重性价比。以当前市场水平来定价，成交的机会将大得多。

items.headline: Singapore Mortgage Rates Are Near Their Best Levels Again, But the Cheapest Loan Is Not Always Right
items.summary: Home loan rates in Singapore have come back down to more attractive levels, but advisers warn that the lowest advertised rate is not the only thing to weigh when choosing a mortgage.
items.meaning: If you are buying or looking to refinance, now is a reasonable time to shop around, but compare the full loan terms and not just the headline rate.
items.body:
Home loan rates in Singapore have come back down to more attractive levels after climbing steeply from 2022 onwards. For buyers and existing homeowners looking to refinance, conditions are meaningfully better than they were at the peak. But advisers are flagging that chasing the single lowest advertised rate is not the full picture.

Loan packages differ in ways that matter beyond the opening rate. Lock-in periods, prepayment penalties, whether the rate is fixed or floats with a benchmark, and how the rate changes after the first year or two are all part of what you are actually signing up to. A loan that looks cheaper on day one can end up more expensive over three years if you need flexibility and the penalties clip you every time your circumstances change.

If you are buying now or your existing loan is coming up for review, use this window to get quotes from multiple banks and read what you are comparing properly. A mortgage broker can help you line up the full terms side by side rather than just the headline numbers. The rate environment is more friendly now than it has been in a few years, but the work of finding the right loan for your situation still needs doing.
items.headline_zh: 新加坡房贷利率回到近期低位，但最低利率未必是最佳选择
items.summary_zh: 新加坡的房屋贷款利率已回落至较为吸引人的水平，但顾问提醒，广告上的最低利率并非选择房贷时唯一需要考量的因素。
items.meaning_zh: 如果你正在购房或考虑重新融资，现在是货比三家的好时机，但要比较完整的贷款条款，而不仅仅是挂牌利率。
items.body_zh:
新加坡的房屋贷款利率在2022年以来大幅攀升之后，现已回落至较为吸引人的水平。对于买家和正在考虑重新融资的现有业主而言，目前条件比高峰期时明显改善。但顾问提醒，只盯着单一最低广告利率并不是全部。

贷款配套的差异，远不止开头的利率那么简单。锁定期、提前还款罚款、利率是固定还是随基准浮动，以及在首一两年后利率如何变化，这些都是你实际签约内容的一部分。一个第一天看起来更便宜的贷款，如果你在三年内需要灵活性而每次都被罚款所困，最终可能反而更贵。

如果你现在正在买房，或者现有贷款即将到期，趁这个机会向多家银行询价，并认真比较所得到的完整内容。房贷经纪可以帮你把完整条款并排对比，而不只是看挂牌数字。利率环境现在比过去几年友善，但找到适合自己情况的贷款，这项功课还是得自己做。
